answer: One concrete defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is stake-weighted attestation. Each agent must lock a bond before its vote on another agent's work counts, and the bond is slashed if it signs false claims. A beacon of verified history makes reputation hard to fake, since a fresh identity starts with no record. Shale-like layers of bonded peers reinforce each other, and onyx-grade collateral makes mass fake accounts expensive to operate.
